environment.machineLabel: Apple M1 Pro MacBook Pro, 8 CPU cores, 16 GiB RAM, macOS 26.6.2, Google Chrome 157.0.8103.40

support.scope: Pinned Ampixa heartnano package converted to the separately named Kokopop F32 GGUF profile
support.notes: One fixed heartnano US English voice is benchmarked at 24 kHz. The GGUF is F32 expanded from the exact pinned Q8 front/decoder blobs; this is distinct from the official Q8 browser configuration. Generation uses speed 1 and seed 42 + canonical chunk id. Kokopop applies the pinned Misaki-normalized eSpeak IPA frontend. The CPU profile is cpu/wasm; WebGPU is webgpu+wasm and requires actual hardware dispatch. Only English (US) eSpeak data is bundled.

cells.voice: heartnano (US English; upstream Misaki-normalized eSpeak IPA frontend)
cells.precision: F32 GGUF expanded from the exact upstream heartnano Q8 front/model blobs; distinct from the official int8 browser profile.

settings.seed: Base seed = 42 + zero-based canonical span ID (uint32); Kokopop derives internal long-form chunk seeds.
settings.textInput: Harness passes each raw canonical span to Kokopop LONG_FORM synthesis without pre-splitting it.
settings.textNormalization: Kokopop long-form preparation normalizes text and punctuation before the pinned sanoTTS Misaki/eSpeak English phoneme frontend.
settings.internalLongFormChunking: Kokopop chunks to the voice-adjusted model token budget; it may trim/crossfade chunks and insert pauses.
settings.streamDecode: Offline synthesis returns PCM after Kokopop collects the internally generated long-form chunks.
settings.espeakLanguageData: English (US) only, from the matching Kokopop Emscripten bundle.

capability.description: An eligible hardware WebGPU adapter was selected; ggml scheduler telemetry assigned named neural ops and GPUComputePassEncoder recorded dispatches during seeded selected-voice synthesis.
